title: Write the work plan's data for the site
description: Writes assets/beans/index.json (folio-bean-index/v1) and assets/beans/count.json into a built site from this folio's bean store, with cat-harness's own functions (the store, block edges both ways, findings, milestone rollup, open count and unit), so the platform's work-plan board and the navbar's beans badge read exactly the shape they read on the platform. A store that does not exist writes nothing and says so.
